title: backlog.py show ID --field F on a deleted item accepts an unknown field and prints {}, where a live item exits 2
goal: show ID --field F for a deleted item exits 2 naming the allowed fields when F is unknown, as it does for a live item

run:
import json,os,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools/backlog.py");r=P.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir="/tmp"))
g=lambda *a:s.run(["git","-C",str(r),*a],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
g("init","-q");(r/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}));(r/"items").mkdir()
f=r/"items"/"ST-aaaaaaaa.json"
f.write_text(json.dumps(dict(id="ST-aaaaaaaa",kind="story",title="t",status="done",priority="P3",goal="g"),indent=2)+"\n")
c=lambda m:(g("add","-A"),g("-c","user.name=x","-c","user.email=x@x","commit","-qm",m))
c("a");f.unlink();c("d")
p=s.run([sys.executable,T,"--root",str(r),"show","ST-aaaaaaaa","--field","bogus"],capture_output=True,text=True)
print(p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()[-80:],p.stderr.strip()[-80:])
sys.exit(0 if p.returncode==2 else 1)
